Thunder storms form over areas heated up during the hot afternoon when sun is out high and hot in clear air above land areas. Sun's warmth makes the lower air warm up a ton as air goes higher in height and temperature. When hot warm air has too big up it can no longer be contained in a place. The rising and spreading up air coasts away, letting out air and pressure down low to create low spots and high winds, and making space for a lot moody rain. Rain comes with the clouds as water drops. Sometimes as it falls down, some gets cold enough up and turn back
